official_name: Sub-Inspector of Police (Civil) - Men and Women (Posts Code 11, SCT SI Civil), Andhra Pradesh
source: SLPRB_AP_SI_Notification_2026.pdf, Rc.No.81/SLPRB/Rect.1/2026 dated 16-09-2026 (42 pages), apply at https://slprb.ap.gov.in
verified_note: Every number below was read from the notification PDF by Claude on 2026-09-21. The application dates are NOT in the PDF: they will come in a press release.

eligibility.age_relaxation_note: EWS, BC (non-creamy layer), SC, ST: up to 5 years. Government employee of AP State Government: length of regular service, up to 5 years (APTRANSCO, DISCOMs, APGENCO, corporations, municipalities and local bodies are NOT entitled). Ex-servicemen: 3 years in addition to service rendered. NCC whole-time instructor: 3 years in addition to service (minimum 6 months of service). Retrenched temporary State Census employee (min 6 months in 1991): up to 3 years. No other relaxation (page 6). Age is taken from the SSC, Matriculation or equivalent certificate only (horoscopes, affidavits, birth extracts and service records are not accepted).
eligibility.qualification: Any degree as on 2026-07-01. SC/ST: a pass in Intermediate (or equivalent) is enough as on 2026-07-01, and the candidate should have studied a degree in a university in India.

stages_pc11.mode: OMR, objective (no negative marking is mentioned)

papers.name: Paper 1 - Arithmetic and Test of Reasoning

stages_pc11.qualifying_note: The percentage must be reached in EACH paper. Prelim marks do not count in the final merit.

stages_pc11.rule: Post Code 11: pass/fail only, no marks (the Annexure I gradation marks apply only to Post Codes 12 and 31). 1600 m plus ONE of 100 m or long jump. Electronic timing, no spike shoes, no re-test.

papers.name: Paper III - Arithmetic and Test of Reasoning

stages_pc11.merit: Paper III + Paper IV = 400 marks. Papers I and II are qualifying only (failing either disqualifies). Ties: older candidate first.
stages_pc11.qualifying_note: The percentage must be reached in EACH of the four final papers (page 13). Papers I and II are qualifying only and not counted in merit. Papers III and IV are set in English, Telugu and Urdu, and the language choice cannot be changed later.

general_studies: Current events of national and international importance
History of India (social, economic, cultural, political aspects and the Indian National Movement)
Indian Polity and Economy (political system, rural development, planning, economic reforms)
